considered: Store::migrate's per-step loop (kept, widened to record each step's hash in one transaction); a schema check against sqlite_master in place of hashes (rejected: the incident's store and a released one differ forever by column order); storing step text instead of a hash (no shorter)

cut: In src/store.rs, call the free migrate function directly from Store::open and delete the forwarding method, validate schema_steps as SQLite yields rows and set the loop start to at when any row exists instead of collecting a Vec, reuse the step lookup for hash validation and the refusal text, and format the SHA-256 digest directly as lowercase hex instead of formatting each byte.
answer: Made all but the last: Store::open calls migrate, the forwarding method is gone; rows are checked as read, first = at on any row; one step lookup serves the check and the refusal. The digest cannot be formatted as lowercase hex directly: sha2 0.11's Array implements no LowerHex (E0277), so the per-byte hex stays, as in scan.rs.
